user.title: Uber Eats
user.description: Connect your Uber Eats account. Your account name will be fetched automatically from your profile.

data_description.time_zone: Must match Home Assistant's time zone.
data_description.cookie: Full cookie string from ubereats.com. Open DevTools (F12) → Network tab → refresh page → click any request → copy 'Cookie' header value.
data_description.auth_cookie: Optional, lets the integration renew the session itself instead of asking for a new cookie every month. In DevTools → Application → Cookies → https://auth.uber.com, copy the values as 'sid=...; csid=...; smeta=...'. Best taken from a separate login (a private window you close without logging out), because each renewal replaces csid.
